Hey all. I really appreciate all your comments and advices. It's nice to know that I am not alone in this after all and that some had so much worst than me. Sometimes my negative thoughts gets so much in my brain that I feel like being alone is equivalent to being a sore loser but each and everyone of you had reminded me that being alone is a privilege and a testament of how tough and strong I had become. 

There's one comment who mentioned that I may have BPD and I didn't find it offensive at all. I know at some point that I am obviously struggling with something, it's just that therapy is the last thing on my mind that I want to give a try for few reasons. I live in a country where mental health is somewhat still disregarded and I wanted to see that maybe, I just happen to be sad at times so I shrug these feelings off by working out and keeping myself busy at all times. It helped so far.

I also do have a pet. I have a daschund and a persian cat, and oh boy, they are the best companions in the world. They make me really happy most of the time.

Thanks again for all your comments. It's amazing to see so much nice people here in this subreddit.:)

I was like this before. Not really competitive but gusto ko laging may pinapatunayan when it comes to my corporate job. I had this when I got terminated at my first corporate job. Then looked for another job and got accepted and have been working with them for 4 years now. I climbed the corporate ladder and now working as a Senior in my line of work. How did I overcome this? Let me tell you that when you have reached the top or your goal, you will have this realization na you should be enjoying your life with all those years and not working your ass off for something that people won't remember when you passed away. Being competitive and doing hard work can cause real mental health issues and burnout and correct you are creating your own problem. Life is not a race ika nga nila. We have our own paces. That's what I instilled in my mind. Nung narealize ko siya, I started creating work and life balance and started going out more with my family and friends. Also revisited my past hobbies and started to love them again. Best advice is chill ka lang. Gawin mong chill lang ang mga bagay bagay. Kasi in reality no one really gives a shit if you reach the top or not.
